LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.InitialTheme.La: Lock the starting story theme to Simulation beginning
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.InitialTheme.De: When enabled, the Wheel of Fate will prioritize the "Simulation beginning" story theme at the start of the game. This is a relaxed starting theme.
Story themes available for automatic selection
Unchecked story themes have their selection weight reduced to 0 and will not be selected naturally.
This theme does not participate in natural rotation. It is entered automatically only when both the starting theme priority setting and this theme are enabled.

LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.Details.Descrip: When enabled, display the theme type when the story theme changes.
